title: Investigating Business in a Competitive Environment

questions.stimulus: Case study insert detailing options for corporate technological upgrades.
questions.question_text: Assess the usefulness of decision trees in strategic decision-making under conditions of uncertainty.
questions.mark_scheme: AO1 (2 marks) Knowledge of expected values/probabilities. AO2 (2 marks) Application to case options. AO3/AO4 (6 marks) Analysis and evaluation of quantitative limitations versus qualitative factors.
